summary: Official SEDUH/IDE-DF territorial-cadastre metadata and a bounded anonymous query verified registered-lot polygon geometry with native objectid identities. The exact WUP point returned zero features, while the surrounding envelope returned three polygons and exceededTransferLimit=true; no absence inference is made.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Portuguese discovery queries, the SEDUH regional portal flow, ArcGIS service/layer metadata, exact-point query, and bounded envelope query were executed and recorded in city-6014-sudoeste-e-octogonal.json. One initial POST failed with HTTP 419 because no page session cookie was supplied; the normal fresh-session retry succeeded. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or global TLS-verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: The Distrito Federal SEDUH public Parcelamentos do Solo portal is a local/regional custodian for RA-XXII - Sudoeste/Octogonal, while IDE-DF exposes the SEDUH territorial-cadastre ArcGIS service. The portal's process records and the parcel layer are distinct evidence types.
routesAttempted: All discovery URLs, route methods, parameters, statuses, and outcomes are recorded in city-6014-sudoeste-e-octogonal.json.
schemaAndCrs: Verified ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 10, Lotes Registrados, polygon geometry; service/source CRS EPSG:31983; retained sample coordinates are output as EPSG:4326.
